metadata.description: Claude Code plugins published by Ideamans — starting with gridgram (grid-based diagrams) and expanding from there.

plugins.name: gridgram
plugins.description: Adds /gg-render, /gg-icons, and /gg-author skills for authoring grid-based diagrams with gridgram.

plugins.name: chartjs2img
plugins.description: Adds /chartjs2img-render, /chartjs2img-author, and /chartjs2img-install skills for generating Chart.js charts as server-rendered PNG/JPEG images.

plugins.name: apple-app-store-connect-cli
plugins.description: Adds /asc-usage and /asc-install skills for the App Store Connect API: apps, versions, builds, TestFlight, in-app purchases, pricing, availability, screenshots and submission.

plugins.name: google-play-developer-publishing-cli
plugins.description: Adds /gplay-usage and /gplay-install skills for the Google Play Developer Publishing API (Android Publisher v3) — upload AABs, manage tracks and staged rollouts, edit store listings, handle in-app products and subscriptions, and read reviews and orders.

plugins.name: crux-cli
plugins.description: Adds /crux-usage and /crux-install skills for querying Chrome UX Report (CrUX) real-user performance data — Core Web Vitals for any origin or URL, from BigQuery or the CrUX API.

plugins.name: hatena-blog-cli
plugins.description: Adds /hatena-blog-usage and /hatena-blog-install skills for publishing to Hatena Blog (はてなブログ) from the command line: create, fetch, update and delete entries via AtomPub, with Markdown, Hatena syntax or HTML bodies.

plugins.name: mfk-cli
plugins.description: Adds /mfk-usage and /mfk-install skills for the Money Forward Kessai (マネーフォワードケッサイ) API v2 — customers, credit examinations, billings, transactions, payouts and destinations from the command line.

plugins.name: misoca-cli
plugins.description: Adds /misoca-usage and /misoca-install skills for Misoca — create and fetch invoices (請求書), estimates (見積書) and delivery slips (納品書), download their PDFs, and manage contacts, contact groups and items from the command line.

plugins.name: rakkokeyword-cli
plugins.description: Adds /rakkokeyword-usage and /rakkokeyword-install skills for keyword research with the rakkokeyword (ラッコキーワード) API — search suggestions, SEO metrics, Google rank checks, competitor analysis and content briefs for the Japanese search market.

plugins.name: vultr-cli
plugins.description: Adds /vultr-usage and /vultr-install skills for driving the Vultr API from the command line: instances, block storage, DNS, load balancers, Kubernetes and every other Vultr service.

plugins.name: static-webshot
plugins.description: Adds /static-webshot-usage and /static-webshot-install skills for deterministic web page screenshots and visual regression diffs — animations, carousels, autoplay and clocks are suppressed so the same page renders identically twice.

plugins.name: gitlab-op
plugins.description: Adds /gitlab-op-usage and /gitlab-op-install skills for provisioning GitLab: creating groups and projects and inviting people to them, against self-hosted GitLab or gitlab.com, with per-instance credential profiles.

plugins.name: go-loadshow
plugins.description: Adds /loadshow-usage and /loadshow-install skills for recording web page loads as MP4 video and placing two recordings side by side, with network and CPU throttling so the result resembles a real visit.

plugins.name: rust-http-playback-proxy
plugins.description: Adds /http-playback-proxy-usage and /http-playback-proxy-install skills for recording a web page's HTTP traffic and replaying it with the original timing, so page-speed work can be measured against a target that does not change between runs.

plugins.name: mautic-cli
plugins.description: Adds /mautic-usage and /mautic-install skills for Mautic marketing automation — read and write contacts, segments, campaigns and emails, query the stats tables for traffic and email performance, and switch between Mautic instances with named credential profiles.

plugins.name: gemini-image-recognize-cli
plugins.description: Adds /gemini-image-recognize-usage and /gemini-image-recognize-install skills for describing images with Gemini: captions and text transcription for search indexes, batch indexing to JSON Lines, and automatic downscaling to fit an upload ceiling.
